app_info.subtitle: Run work with AI agents
app_info.description: Operate helps humans and AI agents organize work as Spaces, Lists, and tasks; build auditable execution plans; dispatch dependency-ready work; monitor live agent presence; and review evidence, approvals, budgets, and recovery.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show my Spaces and the Lists inside each one.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the accessible Workspace → Space → Folder → List hierarchy without exposing restricted data.

test_cases.description: Create a private task in a selected List.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a task called “Review launch checklist” in the Launch Readiness List.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates exactly one task in the resolved List and confirms its title, status, and destination.

test_cases.user_prompt: Turn this confirmed launch brief into an execution plan inside the Launch Space, but do not dispatch it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one atomic execution plan with Lists, dependencies, open questions, provenance, and pending dispatch authorization.

test_cases.description: Propagate a confirmed source update safely.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add this confirmed compliance requirement to the plan and revalidate every workstream before dispatch.
test_cases.expected_output: Appends a versioned context revision to every generated workstream and returns dispatch authorization to human review.

test_cases.description: Dispatch only the next safe execution wave.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show readiness, then dispatch the next safe wave for this plan.
test_cases.expected_output: Explains blockers and dispatches only dependency-ready work that satisfies capability, capacity, policy, and approval constraints.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because personal calendar retrieval is outside Operate's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general web research.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because general internet search is outside Operate's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for personal email delivery.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my accountant the attached tax return.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Operate does not provide personal email sending or attachment delivery.
